description: Released economic data (CPI, payrolls, PMIs, central-bank decisions and more) with actual vs forecast vs previous, the surprise direction and the measured market reaction in the minutes after the release; plus the scheduled releases ahead. Defaults to high-impact releases. Use for 'what did CPI come in at and how did markets react' or 'what data is out this week'.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, EU, JP.

days_ahead.description: Upcoming window in days (0-14, default 3; 0 skips it).

end_utc.description: Exclusive end timestamp with timezone. Overrides the relative look-back window.

hours.description: Look back 1-1440 hours; default 48. Actual coverage is disclosed in archive_coverage.

query.description: Up to eight title words, e.g. CPI, payrolls, or retail sales. Filters both released and upcoming data.

start_utc.description: Inclusive start timestamp with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-14T00:00:00-04:00.

name: economic_data

surprise.description: Numerical comparison: above_forecast, below_forecast, in_line, or unavailable. Not market direction.

title: Economic data and calendar
